strapiBlog.title: UAE Introduces Consular Services for Golden Visa Holders Traveling Abroad
strapiBlog.short_description: The UAE Government continues to ensure full support for its residents, no matter where they are. In line with this commitment, authorities have announced groundbreaking new benefits for Golden Visa holders.

data.text:
The UAE Government continues to ensure full support for its residents, no matter where they are. In line with this commitment, authorities have announced groundbreaking new benefits for Golden Visa holders.

Revealed during GITEX Global 2025, these updates make the Golden Visa more than just a residency permit; it now provides an added layer of security for residents who spend time overseas. Here’s everything you need to know about UAE consular services 2025 for Golden Visa holders.

UAE Consular Services 2025: A Strong Step Forward

According to the changes in the Golden Visa, foreign residents with a 10-year residency permit can access consular services when traveling abroad.

The Golden Visa consular support for the visa holders reflects the UAE’s commitment to supporting all residents equally, both inside and outside the country. It also shows the country's goal to attract top talent and provide a safe, stable environment for them and their families.

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs, and Port Security, these services are part of the “Year of Community - Hand in Hand” initiative.

New Golden Visa UAE Benefits

Let’s take a closer look at all the other UAE Golden Visa benefits 2025. From passport help to evacuation plans, here’s a breakdown of all the different changes in the long-term residency visa policy.

24/7 MoFA Hotline for Golden Visa Holders

Golden Visa residents now have access to a round-the-clock hotline via the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA). Whether it’s a medical emergency, travel issue, or documentation problem, help is available anytime, anywhere in the world.

data.description: Connect with our seasoned agents to find out more about our services and exclusive offers.

data.text:
Emergency Assistance and Evacuation Plans

Golden Visa holders will now be included in the UAE's official evacuation and crisis response plans. In case of natural disasters, political unrest, or emergencies, UAE missions abroad will coordinate safe evacuation and support.

Quick Return Document for Lost or Damaged Passports

If a Golden Visa holder loses their passport while overseas, they can now get an electronic Return Document within 30 minutes through MoFA’s digital services. This allows fast re-entry into the UAE.

Support During Bereavement

If a Golden Visa holder passes away abroad, UAE missions will help arrange for the repatriation of remains or assist with local burial, based on the family’s preference. This includes help with formalities and paperwork.

Coverage for Dependents

All new benefits also apply to dependents under the Golden Visa, including spouses and children. This ensures the entire family is covered during international travel or stays.

Golden Visa UAE: Who Is Eligible?

Eligibility for the UAE Golden Visa covers various categories:

  • Property investors with assets worth AED 2 million or more
  • Entrepreneurs with at least AED 10 million in capital
  • Skilled professionals earning over AED 30,000 per month
  • Scientists, doctors, inventors, and researchers
  • Outstanding students and graduates
  • Teachers, content creators, esports professionals, and influencers
  • Celebrities, athletes, and artists
  • Superyacht owners and other unique talent profiles

Dependents such as spouses and children are also covered under the visa, making it a long-term family solution.

faqs.question: Who can access the new consular services?

data.answer: All current and future holders of the UAE Golden Visa and their dependents.

faqs.question: How do I access the 24/7 consular hotline?

data.answer: You can reach the Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ 24-hour support line by calling +971-2-493-1133 from anywhere in the world. The service is available at all times to assist Golden Visa holders with emergencies, travel issues, or other inquiries.

faqs.question: Will my children also be included in these benefits?

data.answer: Yes. All dependents under the Golden Visa are covered by the same services.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Golden Visa applications?

data.answer: A valid passport (with over 6 months' validity), attested qualifications, and, in some cases, a no-objection certificate from an employer or authority.

faqs.question: What is the UAE Golden Visa Pass?

data.answer:
UAE Pass is the country’s national digital identity for citizens, residents, and visitors. It provides secure access to over 15,000 government, semi-government, and private sector services online. 

The integration with platforms like UAE Pass makes access to services easier and more efficient for Golden Visa holders and others.
